design_system.name: Eenera Governance System
design_system.description: Institutional SaaS dashboard aesthetic. Stripe × Palantir fusion. High density, rigorous hierarchy, clean typography.

usage_rules.shadows: Minimal. use shadow-sm or shadow-md only. No large diffuse shadows.
usage_rules.borders: Crisp 1px borders. Use border-slate-200 for containers.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0B1F3B] text-white hover:bg-[#162B4D] shadow-sm rounded-md h-9 px-4 font-medium text-sm transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0B1F3B] border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 shadow-sm rounded-md h-9 px-4 font-medium text-sm transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-[#0B1F3B] text-[#0B1F3B] hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md h-9 px-4
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-[#0B1F3B] hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-md h-9 px-4

component_styles.inputs: h-9 border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1E4FFF] focus:border-[#1E4FFF] rounded-md text-sm

tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider h-10 border-b border-slate-200
tables.row: h-12 border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors text-sm text-slate-700

badges.default: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
badges.success: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
badges.warning: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
badges.error: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
badges.brand: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Size 16px (w-4 h-4) for UI, 20px (w-5 h-5) for Nav.

implementation_instructions.step_1_setup: Update tailwind.config.js with the detailed color palette. Add 'Plus Jakarta Sans' and 'JetBrains Mono' to index.css imports.
implementation_instructions.step_2_components: Customize shadcn components. Force squared/slightly rounded corners (rounded-md). Remove default 'ring' focus styles and replace with 'ring-2 ring-blue-500/20'.
implementation_instructions.step_3_layout: Build the AppShell with a fixed Sidebar (Left) and a sticky Topbar. The main content area should have 'bg-[#F4F6FA]' (secondary background) to differentiate from white cards.
implementation_instructions.step_4_dashboard: Implement the 'Governance Overview'. Use 'recharts' for the Compliance Score Circle (Donut Chart).
implementation_instructions.step_5_tables: The 'Obligation Mapping' view is the core. It needs a high-density Data Table. Use 'tanstack-table' logic if complex, or simple map for MVP. MUST have sticky header.
specific_rules: NO SHADOWS on inputs, only borders.
Status indicators must use the 'dot' pattern (colored w-2 h-2 rounded-full) + text label.
All 'Card' components in the dashboard must have a 'Header' section with a bottom border.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY for sticky headers/overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
